newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai T-bill repo rates end mixed, spots up.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai T-bill repo rates end mixed, spots up.

text.p: Contracts on the treasury bill repurchase market in Shanghai closed mixed on Tuesday with a rebound in the domestic A share markets pushing the early-maturing contracts up, traders said.
The annual rate for the most active seven-day contract rose to 11.68 percent from 11.52 percent on Monday.
Total turnover fell to 6.61 million lots from 9.36 million. One lot is 1,000 yuan face value of treasury bills.
"The rebound in Shanghai's A shares today encouraged some institutions to buy the early-maturing contracts," one trader said.
"If the rebound lasts in the next few days, the most active seven-day contract will move above the 11-percent level," he added.
The listing of Yinchuan Xinhua Department Store Co Ltd on Wednesday was another important factor supporting the seven-day contract, local traders said.
"But rumours that the central bank will cut interest rates in the first quarter of this year is an important psychological factor for many traders in the mid-term," one local trader said.
Contracts on the T-bill spot market in Shanghai ended up mainly due to rumours that the People's Bank of China would cut interest rates in the first quarter, traders said.
The most active 10-year bond that matures in 2006 rose to 118.45 yuan from 117.17 yuan on Monday. Turnover of the bond was 1.62 billion yuan.
Combined volume of the eight-contract market increased to 1.87 million lots from 782,090 lots.
The one-year contract dating from January 1996 matured on Monday and stopped trading today.
Traders said rumours of a possible interest rate cut promoted all the spot contracts today.
"The rises is likely to continue, but technical charts indicate the most active 10-year contract will meet resistance at the 120-121 yuan level in the next few days," a local analyst said.
Local traders said volume on the spot market would decrease with institutions doing less business ahead of the Chinese lunar new year holiday.
